annotations.title: Copy a coaching brain from a code

description: Use this when a coach has another coach's Phorme code and wants to start their own coaching brain from it, for example "start my brain from K7Q2-XR4D". Sent with the code alone, it shows whose brain it is and whether its coach lets other coaches copy it, and changes nothing. Sent with a name and confirmation, it makes a new draft brain from it with its rules and programs, which the coach then makes their own; the coach who made it keeps 10% of what the copy earns. It needs a connected Phorme account; set confirmation to true only after the coach said yes and chose the name.

code.description: The code as the coach gave it, for example "K7Q2-XR4D", or its phor.me/c/ link.

confirmation.description: True only after the coach confirmed the copy and its name.

name.description: The name the coach chose for their copy. Needed to copy.

name: copy_coach_from_code
title: Copy a coaching brain from a code
